messages:
jamal: :rotating_light: seeing a sustained spike of 502/504 from hosted-api in us-west-2 since ~10:12 UTC. Multiple customer reports and elevated error-rate on the gateway. Raising war-room now.

alex: oncall here — joining. jamal, can you paste the quick numbers (p95 p99 errors, impacted routes)?

jamal: p95 error-rate jumped to ~8% on /v1/generate, p99 ~22%. Top affected routes: chat.stream and text.generate. customers: two mid-market customers reporting 30-40% failed calls. Logs show gateway returning 502 from inference-gw and some 504 from edge LB.

maria: looking at runtime metrics — noticed KV-cache eviction rate spiked around 10:10 and batcher queue depth tripled. Also seeing auth-proxy 503s for short windows. attaching quick log snippet: 
```
[10:11:02] inference-gw ERROR request id=abcd auth upstream TLS handshake timeout -> 502
[10:11:07] batcher WARN queue_depth=187 inflight=64
[10:11:09] kv-cache INFO evict key_count=3120 mem_pressure=true
```

alex: ok that's helpful. can we reproduce a single failing request locally or from staging? what's a minimal repro curl?

maria: repro (from internal staging):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}' \
  https://hosted-api.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate --max-time 10
# response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
```
Observed response headers show edge LB timing out waiting for inference-gw.

lina: which customers should support prioritize? any paying enterprise SLAs impacted?

jamal: two support tickets with customers using dedicated endpoints on hosted tiers. SLA is impacted for one customer (enterprise). I'm patching them with status updates; will send email if we confirm root cause.

alex: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) route traffic off the overloaded inference pool to a compatible fallback model variant; 2) scale auth-proxy replicas + increase keepalive; 3) temporarily lower max batch size to reduce queueing and per-request latency. maria, can you run (2) and (3) now? i'll coordinate the routing change with infra.

maria: doing the scale + keepalive now. kubectl snippets: 
```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/auth-proxy --replicas=5
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-gw KEEPALIVE=75
kubectl -n batcher set env deploy/batcher MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=512
```
Scaling auth-proxy replicas up to 5, increasing keepalive. will monitor metrics in 2 mins.

sre-bot: deploy auth-proxy scaled to 5 replicas by maria at 10:28 UTC.

maria: quick check — auth-proxy 5xx reduced after scaling but KV eviction persists on p3 pools. routing to fallback pool started; we should see error-rate drop within next 5 minutes.

alex: thanks. jamal, prioritize customer comms for SLA customer. lina, can you own postmortem comms and customer-facing summary?

lina: yep i'll draft a short summary once we have root-cause and timeline.

jamal: customer update sent (ticket #4567). told them we are mitigating and will follow-up with timeline and action items.

--- 1 hour later ---

alex: short recap from triage: root cause is a response-spiral caused by auth-proxy intermittent TLS handshake latency to upstream KMS (out-of-band) which increased request latency -> batcher queue growth -> KV-cache thrash on certain model hosts due to memory pressure -> more timeouts downstream. Essentially a small auth upstream issue amplified by batching + cache eviction causing cascading 5xx.

maria: confirmed: signed-off on repro where adding artificial auth latency reproduced the 504 spike and KV eviction. Also validated that routing to fallback model and scaling auth-proxy reduced customer impact.

lina: draft postmortem doc created: https://redwood.internal/pmo/5201234567-response-spiral (will add timeline and customer comms).

alex: action items (owners):
- maria: add backpressure circuit breaker around batcher and tune MAX_BATCH_TOKENS (due in 48h)
- alex: implement graceful fallback routing policy for model-hosts when KV eviction > threshold (due in 72h)
- jamal: finish customer follow-ups and SLA remediation plan (due EOD)
- infra: add alert on auth-proxy upstream latency (pager) (assigned to infra team)
- lina: publish customer-facing incident summary and postmortem (due in 72h)

maria: note: also adding a perf regression test that injects auth latency into staging to catch this pattern.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll close war-room once postmortem draft has comments. please add any quick notes here if I missed anything. :thumbsup:
